text: Proposal for the copied What’s New test support: retain the upstream file path and the local reduction when updating the copy. The assigned reviewer requested origin attribution for data/shared.js. The landed comment names toolkit/mozapps/update/tests/data/shared.js and says it was stripped to parts used by browser_showWhatsNewPageTest.js. This tells a maintainer where to compare later upstream changes without implying every upstream helper or style is a Thunderbird contract. Inspect the owned integration, setup and cleanup independently; copied support still has unused retry helpers and is not a fully audited current template. No upstream full-file comparison or update test was executed.
title: Keep copied update-test origin and local scope in its comment
